methodologyNotes: Published self-serve subscription pricing was collected for each consumer video-streaming provider as of the accessed date, with each figure corroborated against a dedicated 2026 pricing-review source where the official pricing page geolocated outside the USA (showed EUR), rendered plans behind a JavaScript plan picker, or omitted standalone tiers. All prices are flat per-account per-month in USD (annual rates recorded as annualDiscountPct where the provider publishes one); these are consumer subscriptions, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null throughout. Add-on/extra-member rates (e.g. Netflix extra member, Prime Video Ultra) are noted in plan notes; no quote-only consumer tiers exist in this vertical.

vendors.name: Netflix
vendors.provenance: https://help.netflix.com/en/node/24926 (official help page geolocated to EUR pricing, so US figures corroborated via dealnews.com and cbsnews.com March 2026 price-increase coverage)

plans.name: Standard with Ads
plans.notes: Ad-supported tier, 1080p Full HD, up to 2 simultaneous streams. Extra member add-on $7.99/mo. Price raised from $7.99 in March 2026.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Ad-free, 1080p Full HD, up to 2 simultaneous streams, downloads. One extra-member slot at $9.99/mo. Price raised from $17.99 in March 2026.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Ad-free, 4K Ultra HD + HDR, up to 4 simultaneous streams, downloads on 6 devices, spatial audio. Two extra-member slots at $9.99/mo each. Price raised from $24.99 in March 2026.

vendors.name: Disney+
vendors.provenance: https://www.disneyplus.com/welcome/filter-plans (official; page lists bundles, so standalone Basic/Premium tiers and annual rate corroborated via dealnews.com June 2026 cost guide)

plans.name: Basic (With Ads)
plans.notes: Ad-supported standalone tier, up to 1080p Full HD, 2 concurrent streams, full library access. No annual option offered for this tier.

plans.name: Premium (No Ads)
plans.notes: Ad-free standalone tier, 4K UHD/HDR/Dolby Vision, 4 concurrent streams, Dolby Atmos, IMAX Enhanced, offline downloads on up to 10 devices. Annual $189.99/yr (~17% off vs monthly).

vendors.name: HBO Max
vendors.provenance: https://www.dealnews.com/features/hbo-max-subscription-cost/ (2026 cost guide listing all three standalone tiers with monthly and annual rates; prices reflect the October 2025 increase)

plans.name: Basic with Ads
plans.notes: Ad-supported, 1080p Full HD, 2 simultaneous streams, full library with commercial breaks; no offline downloads. Annual $109.99/yr.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Ad-free, 1080p Full HD, 2 simultaneous streams, up to 30 offline downloads, live sports access. Annual $184.99/yr (~$36 savings).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Ad-free, 4K Ultra HD with Dolby Atmos, 4 simultaneous streams, up to 100 offline downloads. Annual $229.99/yr (~$45 savings).

vendors.name: Hulu
vendors.provenance: https://www.dealnews.com/features/hulu/monthly-cost/ (2026 pricing guide; on-demand and Hulu + Live TV tiers corroborated via cordcuttersnews.com and yardbarker.com 2026 plan guides)

plans.name: Hulu (With Ads)
plans.notes: Ad-supported on-demand streaming library. Annual $119.99/yr. Student rate $1.99/mo where eligible.

plans.name: Hulu (No Ads)
plans.notes: Ad-free on-demand streaming of the full Hulu library (a few titles excluded due to licensing).

plans.name: Hulu + Live TV (With Ads)
plans.notes: Live TV channels plus the ad-supported Hulu library; bundled with Disney+ and ESPN Select at no extra charge.

plans.name: Hulu + Live TV (No Ads)
plans.notes: Live TV plus the ad-free Hulu on-demand library; bundled with Disney+ (No Ads) and ESPN Select.

vendors.name: Paramount+
vendors.provenance: https://www.dealnews.com/features/Paramount-Plus/Cost/ (2026 cost guide listing both tiers with monthly and annual rates; prices reflect the January 15, 2026 increase)

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Ad-supported, 1080p HD, up to 3 simultaneous streams, full 40,000+ title library, NFL on CBS and UEFA Champions League, UFC Fight Night cards. Annual $89.99/yr. Raised $1 in Jan 2026.

plans.name: Premium (with SHOWTIME)
plans.notes: Ad-free on-demand, 4K UHD/HDR10/Dolby Vision, up to 3 streams, full library plus SHOWTIME originals, local live CBS 24/7, offline downloads. Annual $139.99/yr. Raised $1 in Jan 2026.

vendors.name: Peacock
vendors.provenance: https://www.dealnews.com/features/peacock/cost/ (2026 cost guide listing all three tiers with monthly and annual rates)

plans.name: Select
plans.notes: Ad-supported; current seasons of NBC/Bravo shows plus library content. No Peacock Originals, live sports, or movies; no downloads. Annual $79.99/yr.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Ad-supported full library including Peacock Originals, live sports and events, hit films. Annual $109.99/yr (~$20 savings).

plans.name: Premium Plus
plans.notes: Ad-free (except certain live events), local NBC live stream, offline downloads. Annual $169.99/yr (~$30 savings).

vendors.name: Apple TV+
vendors.provenance: https://www.dealnews.com/features/apple-tv/price/ (2026 pricing guide; single ad-free tier with monthly and annual rates; reflects the August 2025 increase from $9.99 to $12.99)

plans.name: Apple TV+
plans.notes: Single ad-free tier; 4K HDR with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, Apple Originals plus live sports (MLS, Friday Night Baseball), offline downloads, Family Sharing for up to 6 members. Annual $99.99/yr (~$56 savings vs monthly).

vendors.name: Amazon Prime Video
vendors.provenance: https://www.dealnews.com/features/amazon/prime-video-cost/ (2026 cost guide; standalone and Ultra add-on rates corroborated via variety.com and cnbc.com March 2026 Prime Video Ultra coverage)

plans.name: Prime Video (standalone, with ads)
plans.notes: Standalone ad-supported Prime Video without a full Prime membership. Ad-free upgrade via Prime Video Ultra add-on at +$4.99/mo (adds 4K/UHD, up to 5 concurrent streams, 100 downloads).

plans.name: Amazon Prime (membership, with ads)
plans.notes: Full Amazon Prime membership including ad-supported Prime Video plus shipping and other Prime benefits. Annual $139/yr (~$41 savings vs monthly). Ad-free Prime Video via Ultra add-on +$4.99/mo.
